question.zh-CN: 如何根据物体与工艺选择接触方式，而非只增加手指数量？
question.en: How should contact mechanisms be matched to objects and processes beyond adding fingers?

problem.zh-CN: 稳定夹持尺寸或形状不同的物体。
problem.en: Hold objects with varying sizes or shapes.

research.zh-CN: 抓取生成、柔顺设计与接触建模。
research.en: Grasp synthesis, compliance design and contact modeling.

industry.zh-CN: 指尖工装、寿命、夹持检测与接口。
industry.en: Fingertip tooling, life, grasp detection and interfaces.

compare.zh-CN: 开口、夹持力、质量与可替换指尖。
compare.en: Opening, gripping force, mass and replaceable fingertips.

problem.zh-CN: 处理薄片、易损或不规则物体。
problem.en: Handle sheets, fragile items and irregular shapes.

research.zh-CN: 密封接触、材料形变与抓取可行性。
research.en: Sealing contact, deformation and grasp feasibility.

industry.zh-CN: 气源、泄漏、污染与耗材更换。
industry.en: Air supply, leakage, contamination and consumable replacement.

compare.zh-CN: 表面适应性、压差、抓取失败检测。
compare.en: Surface compatibility, pressure differential and failure detection.

problem.zh-CN: 在抓取后继续调整物体姿态。

research.zh-CN: 高维动作学习、手内操作与跨手迁移。
research.en: High-dimensional learning, in-hand manipulation and hand transfer.

industry.zh-CN: 驱动集成、耐久性、触觉布置与供货。
industry.en: Drive integration, durability, tactile placement and supply.

compare.zh-CN: 主动与总自由度、指尖力、控制接口。
compare.en: Active versus total degrees of freedom, fingertip force and control interface.

name.zh-CN: 绳驱、欠驱动与仿生结构

problem.zh-CN: 降低手部重量与驱动数量。
problem.en: Reduce hand mass and actuator count.

research.zh-CN: 耦合辨识、迟滞补偿与形态计算。
research.en: Coupling identification, hysteresis compensation and morphology computation.

industry.zh-CN: 张力调节、传动维护与一致性。
industry.en: Tension adjustment, transmission service and consistency.

compare.zh-CN: 独立可控维度、迟滞、张力与寿命。
compare.en: Independent control dimensions, hysteresis, tension and life.

problem.zh-CN: 在抓取、拧紧、加工等工序间切换。
problem.en: Switch between grasping, fastening and processing.

research.zh-CN: 工具使用推理与接触技能组合。

industry.zh-CN: 快换定位、介质连接、工艺认证。
industry.en: Changer repeatability, utility connections and process qualification.

compare.zh-CN: 换装时间、连接可靠性与工具标定。
compare.en: Changeover time, connection reliability and tool calibration.

problem.zh-CN: 共同支撑、交接或装配物体。
problem.en: Support, hand over or assemble objects cooperatively.

research.zh-CN: 耦合约束、角色分工与协调策略。
research.en: Coupled constraints, role assignment and coordination policies.

industry.zh-CN: 碰撞规避、同步控制与工位布局。
industry.en: Collision avoidance, synchronization and cell layout.

compare.zh-CN: 协调成功率、接触力、同步误差。
compare.en: Coordination success, contact forces and synchronization error.
